source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Enable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 1
2. Run Pulse-Test via cmd: dcgmi diag -v -r pulse_test
3. Disable Persistence-Mode via cmd: nvidia-smi -pm 0

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. The result of Pulse-Test should be PASS without errors.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds pulse scope, transient telemetry, PSU/cooling limits and emergency recovery.

original_test_intent: Exercise DCGM pulse behavior on the approved GPUs, verify the diagnostic and transient voltage/power/thermal response without errors, and restore the approved persistence state.
original_method: Validate pulse_test support and scope, isolate workloads, arm sufficiently sampled GPU and platform power/thermal/voltage telemetry with hard aborts, execute the source persistence/pulse sequence, correlate events and restore state.
manual_activity: One authorized user approves the fixed transient-load plan. The stimulus, high-rate telemetry, stop predicates and evidence capture are software-controlled; no physical observation is required by the source.
required_inputs: Compatible DCGM/driver and stable GPU target map
Proof of source `-v -r pulse_test` syntax and actual plugin scope
Pulse duration/coverage, workload/MIG blackout and telemetry sampling requirements
GPU/board/PSU/cooling power, voltage if exposed, thermal, ECC and timeout limits
Persistence final state and OOB/recovery approval
safety_requirements: Verify no protected workload/MIG client and sufficient PSU/cooling headroom.
Use sampling fast enough to capture pulses; enforce power, voltage where exposed, thermal, ECC, PSU/BMC and driver Safety Stops.
Preserve the first transient violation and raw samples; do not infer safety from sparse polling.
No automatic retry, limit change, GPU reset, client termination or service restart.
Restore only the approved persistence state.
agent_execution_scope: Validate plugin, target, blackout, telemetry rate, limits and recovery readiness.
Execute the source pulse plan with synchronized high-rate GPU/platform monitoring and automatic Safety Stop.
Collect raw diagnostic/transient/event evidence, restore state and report Tool Result.
engineer_actions: Approve pulse scope/duration, telemetry adequacy, platform limits, blackout and recovery/restoration plan.
Resolve any transient violation or incomplete sampling.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `--pulse` is not proven equivalent to source `-v -r pulse_test`; it omits verbosity and persistence transitions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source selector after installed-version validation; use an alternate only with equivalent pulse coverage and verbosity proof.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The selector, verbosity, persistence transitions, criterion, script and 2/40-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: SOURCE PULSE TEST RETAINED WITH TRANSIENT TELEMETRY
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run stable targets under a fixed pulse plan while collecting time-aligned DCGM, GPU, BMC and PSU telemetry at a rate justified for expected pulse duration, with deterministic hard stops.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: DCGM-supported GPU/platform combinations exposing required pulse and platform telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record DCGM/dcgmi, driver, GPU firmware/SKU, nvidia-smi, BMC/PSU and OS/kernel.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA DCGM diagnostics documentation for the deployed release and referenced project script.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds transient sampling adequacy, board/PSU limits and enforceable Safety Stops without replacing the pulse diagnostic.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected pulse timescale and platform telemetry capability.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Sparse sensors may miss peaks; unavailable voltage telemetry must be disclosed rather than synthesized.

project_override_considerations: A project may set duration, target GPUs, sampling rate and limits. Report actual pulse coverage and any unavailable sensor; do not claim unobserved voltage behavior.
expected_evidence: Versions, stable targets, workload blackout and GPU/PSU/cooling baseline
Resolved selector and full verbose diagnostic with sub-results, duration, timestamps and return code
Safety Stop if any, post events and persistence restoration
Tool Result separated from engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source title, selector and PASS criterion consistently specify pulse_test; historical spelling differences are applicability issues.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Intent is clear and machine-executable. Missing sampling/limits/package are readiness inputs; unavailable voltage sensing is an evidence limitation to disclose.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects read-only status, preserves persistence and adds transient sampling and platform protection.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its pulse-specific safeguards while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates plan approval, Tool Result and engineer verdict and prohibits automatic retry.

review_improvement: Treats Pulse-Test as a transient measurement problem, preventing false assurance from an aggregate PASS plus slow telemetry.
independent_technical_reasoning: No physical setup or human visual judgment is intrinsic to the pulse test. Automated instrumentation and stop controls can execute the core once project limits and sensor adequacy are approved.
